cfg.scrollback: Scrollback lines kept by the TermMoor webview terminal.
cfg.shellIntegration: Inject lightweight OSC 133/633 shell integration hooks so TermMoor can detect active CLI/Agent commands, track live working directories, jump between prompts (Ctrl+Up/Down), capture exact last-command output, and notify on long-running commands.
cfg.longRunningThreshold: Notify when a background or unfocused command finishes after running at least this many seconds. Set to 0 to disable.
